stories.script: In business. French power firm Schneider Electric is buying P T C, a maker of factory software. It is Schneider's biggest deal ever.

stories.script: In security. Posing as A I firm an-thropic, hackers sent policy experts files that break into accounts. Researchers link them to China.
stories.screen: a small glowing envelope with a fishing hook hanging above it, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: From Taiwan. T S M C, the biggest chip maker, reportedly plans higher prices next year. Buyers want more new chips than it can make.
stories.screen: a small glowing computer chip with a plain upward arrow beside it, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In robotics. Germany is paying for tens of thousands of drone hunters, built in Ukraine. They are meant to stop Russia's newer, faster attack drones.
stories.screen: a small glowing four-rotor drone with a simple shield shape beneath it, text-free symbol

stories.script: In new models. N-vidia-backed American start-up Reflection may soon release an A I anyone can download. It would rival China's best free models.
stories.screen: a small glowing open box with a simple brain shape rising out of it, text-free symbol

stories.script: In health. A Stanford team used thousands of A I helpers to read old drug trials. Drugs aimed at genes found in few kinds of cells did better. It is a clue, not proof.
stories.screen: a small glowing pill capsule under a simple magnifying glass, text-free symbol

stories.script: In daily life. McDonald's reportedly sets menu prices with A I, store by store. It calls the tool optional; some owners say they feel pushed.
stories.screen: a small glowing hamburger with a blank price tag hanging from it, simple text-free and number-free symbol

fun.script: And something lighter. Munchy's Pizza, a Florida family shop, promised never to use A I. The promise drew tens of thousands of people online.
fun.screen: a small glowing pizza slice with a simple heart floating above it, text-free symbol

teaser.script: Also in the full report. I B M says a quantum computer beat a supercomputer in a test. Kyiv reportedly has A I guns against drones.
teaser.screen: a small glowing stack of papers with a bookmark ribbon on top, simple text-free symbol

bp.script: And for the bigger picture: investors keep buying A I shares. Yet borrowing costs are the highest since two thousand two. Watch interest rates; if they stay high, those shares could fall.
